messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

First draft of the lease attached (engrossment to follow once agreed). As per heads of terms: break at 29 September 2031 on nine months' notice, 28-day... sorry, 21-day forfeiture trigger, interest at 4% over base. Over to you.

Elena

messages.snippet: Elena, Our mark-up attached. Three changes of substance, all consistent with what Brookmere flagged
messages.subject: RE: Pinnacle House - lease (first draft for mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Our mark-up attached. Three changes of substance, all consistent with what Brookmere flagged at heads of terms stage:

1. Break notice reduced from nine months to six months.
2. Forfeiture trigger moved from 21 days to 28 days.
3. Default interest reduced from 4% to 3% over base.

Everything else we can live with. If your client agrees these three, we are at agreed form.

Nadia

messages.plaintextBody:
Grace, Edward,

The tenant has asked for three changes to the lease: break notice down to six months, forfeiture trigger up to 28 days, and default interest down to 3% over base. None of these is unusual for a covenant of this strength and I'd recommend accepting all three to lock in the agreed form. Let me know you're content and I'll confirm to Pemberton Rowe.

Elena
